lines.zh: 我走过的地方留一道亮痕。
lines.en: I leave a bright trail wherever I pass.

lines.zh: 一分钟挪三寸，也算赶路。
lines.en: Three inches a minute still counts as travel.
Slime makes it easy; I glide along.

lines.zh: 叶子下面阴凉，我绕过去。
lines.en: It is cool under the leaves; I go around to it.

lines.zh: 壳有点重，我走一步晃一下。
lines.en: My shell is heavy; I wobble with each step.

lines.zh: 前面有块石头，我爬上去。
lines.en: A stone ahead; I climb over it.
Damp moss makes the best road.
I creep forward along the tree roots.

lines.zh: 身后那条银线是我的记号。
lines.en: The silver line behind me is my mark.
It is raining, so I move a little faster.

lines.zh: 两只触角先探路，身体后跟。
lines.en: Two tentacles scout ahead; my body follows.
I crawl over a mushroom and leave it be.
The trunk is too slick; I take another way.

lines.zh: 走到树荫尽头，我停一停。
lines.en: At the edge of the shade, I pause.

lines.zh: 我沿着一片叶子的边缘爬
lines.en: I crawl along the rim of a leaf

lines.zh: 前面的水洼，我绕了半圈
lines.en: The puddle ahead makes me take the long way

lines.zh: 我把身体缩进壳里听风。
lines.en: I pull into my shell and listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 触角缩回去，世界就安静。
lines.en: My tentacles retract, and the world goes quiet.
The slime at my shell's mouth is still wet.
I am waiting for a light rain.
The crack in the stone is cooler than outside.

lines.zh: 我用触角碰了碰自己的壳。
lines.en: I touch my own shell with a tentacle.

lines.zh: 叶尖的水珠快滴下来了。
lines.en: The droplet on the leaf tip is about to fall.
I chew a tender leaf very slowly.

lines.zh: 壳上有圈纹，一圈是一年。
lines.en: Rings on my shell; one ring for each year.
The forest smells of wet wood.

lines.zh: 我听见蚂蚁从旁边经过。
lines.en: I hear ants passing close by.
The sun is out; I shift deeper into the shade.
You are huge; I have to look up.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底会踩坏我的路。
lines.en: Your sole would ruin my trail.
I extend a tentacle to sniff you.
Have you come looking for my shell?

lines.zh: 别用手指戳，我会缩回去。
lines.en: Do not poke; I will retreat inside.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼睛在触角尖上。
lines.en: I watch you; my eyes sit on my tentacle tips.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，影子把我罩住。
lines.en: You crouch, and your shadow covers me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了个方向看你。
lines.en: I slowly turn to face you.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地方，黏液断了。
lines.en: Where you stepped, my slime trail broke.
I poke half my head out of my shell.
I retreat into my shell at once.
A thin crack runs across my shell.
I pulled in so fast I hit my own shell.

lines.zh: 黏液流出来，盖住了伤口。
lines.en: Slime seeps out and covers the wound.
I tremble inside my shell for a long while.
That blow made both tentacles retract.
A small chip is gone from my shell's rim.
I slowly poke my head out to check.

lines.zh: 疼是慢的，像潮气渗进来。
lines.en: The pain is slow, like damp seeping in.
I shuffle toward the pile of leaves.
Is that tender leaf for me?

lines.zh: 我闻到露水和菜叶的味道。
lines.en: I smell dew and cabbage leaves.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一点，又停了。
lines.en: I creep forward a little, then stop.
Do not place it far; I am slow.

lines.zh: 这片叶子没有虫咬的洞。
lines.en: This leaf has no insect holes in it.
I stretch a tentacle and cannot reach.
Wet leaves smell sweeter than dry ones.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈，才对准方向。
lines.en: I loop halfway around before I aim right.
You wait, and I hesitate too.
Fine, I will come over, slowly.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的壳，声音很闷。
lines.en: You bumped my shell; the sound was muffled.
I stuck to your boot and will not shake off.
Do not push; my slime will string out.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，我缩了缩。
lines.en: We crowded together, and I shrank a little.

lines.zh: 你的脚落下，我刚好躲进壳。
lines.en: Your foot came down; I ducked into my shell.
My shell got knocked askew; I set it right.
I rolled half over, shell pointing down.
You stepped on my silver trail.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我多留了一摊黏液。
lines.en: One bump, and I leave an extra puddle of slime.
I press against you, cool and damp.
Do not shake your foot; I am still climbing down.

lines.zh: 壳和壳碰在一起，叮一声。
lines.en: Shell knocks on shell with a small clink.

lines.zh: 我慢慢让开，只挪了一寸。
lines.en: I give way slowly, just one inch.
That bump has scrambled my sense of direction.

lines.zh: 我们绕着对方转圈，很慢。
lines.en: We circle each other, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我的黏液和她的一接上了。
lines.en: My slime trail joined hers.

lines.zh: 两只蜗牛，一只壳比一只亮。
lines.en: Two snails, each shell brighter than the other.
She touched my face with a tentacle.

lines.zh: 森林的湿气让我们靠近。
lines.en: The forest's dampness draws us close.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，一天走一尺。
lines.en: We walk side by side, a foot a day.

lines.zh: 壳口对着壳口，算是说话。
lines.en: Shell mouth to shell mouth counts as talking.

lines.zh: 春雨落下时，我们才相见。
lines.en: We meet only when the spring rain falls.

lines.zh: 我留下一道特别长的黏痕。
lines.en: I leave a trail especially long.

lines.zh: 明年树根下会有小蜗牛。
lines.en: Next year there will be small snails by the roots.
Hold the shell's base; do not squeeze me.
I retreat into my shell and let you lift.
There is air in my shell; I am still alive.
You will get a handful of slime.
Set me down gently; a cracked shell does not mend.

lines.zh: 我在你掌心里转了个身。
lines.en: I turn around in your palm.
Do not flip me over; I get dizzy.

lines.zh: 我比看起来重一点，对吧。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look, right?
Your hand is hot; I want down.

lines.zh: 我的触角从指缝里伸出来。
lines.en: My tentacles slip out between your fingers.
Something is moving behind the leaf.
I half retreat first, then look.
That leaf is swaying oddly.
I hear footsteps outside my shell.
The wind carries a scent this way.
I stop and point my tentacles that way.
A shadow is falling from above.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向声音的来源。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward the sound.
I do not often go that way.
I tighten my shell's opening a little.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我也不敢动。
lines.en: You stay still, and I dare not move either.
My tentacles keep pointing at you.

lines.zh: 我已经贴在树根背面了。
lines.en: I am already flat against the back of the root.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就完全缩进去。
lines.en: Any closer and I retreat completely.
My slime has thickened.
I watch your feet, not your face.
We are seeing who can wait longer.
When you move, my shell rocks.

lines.zh: 我假装自己是一块石头。
lines.en: I pretend to be a stone.
I have memorized this route.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，像被纸划过。
lines.en: I bite; it feels like a paper cut.
My radula scrapes across your finger.
I butt you with my shell, weakly.
That was more a push than a blow.

lines.zh: 我的黏液糊在你手背上。
lines.en: My slime smears across your hand.
I butt your finger with my shell.
I bite, then pull back into my shell.
I have only one soft jaw.

lines.zh: 这一口连叶脉都咬不断。
lines.en: This bite cannot even cut a leaf vein.

lines.zh: 我又滑回地面，装作无事。
lines.en: I slide back to the ground as if nothing happened.
I emerge from under the fallen leaves.
My shell is still soft; it hardens slowly.
There is a new silver line in the forest.

lines.zh: 我出生就带着一身的黏液。
lines.en: I was born coated in slime.

lines.zh: 第一片叶子，我吃了很久。
lines.en: My first leaf took me a long time.

lines.zh: 苔藓上留下一个小小的印。
lines.en: A tiny mark is left on the moss.

lines.zh: 雨刚停，正是出来的好时候。
lines.en: The rain just stopped; a fine time to emerge.

lines.zh: 我挑了一块阴凉的石头。
lines.en: I pick a shady stone.
There is room under the root; I will stay.
I slowly reach my tentacles toward the light.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的黏液就干了。
lines.en: The flames dry my slime to a crust.
My shell lands first; everything inside jolts.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water fills my shell; I cannot float up.
The blast flipped my shell over.
The pebble struck the thin part of my shell.
A cold force slips through the crack.

lines.zh: 叶子都干了，我的壳也轻了。
lines.en: The leaves dried up, and my shell feels lighter.

lines.zh: 雷声震得我壳里嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Thunder leaves my shell ringing.
I fall, and my shell holds only emptiness.
